# EarthState

> World models for infrastructure. EarthState is a series of research prototypes developed by the research team of Dr.-Ing. Daguang Han; this site shows the results and hosts the demos. There are two platforms with different jobs: EarthState Twin builds a structure's model, digital twin and capacity check from drawings and records, through a conversation, for an engineer to sign; Standfast judges assets in service (hazard scenarios, collapse margins, strengthening and maintenance priorities). Both were built first for transmission towers and overhead lines, with bridges next, and sit across four industry products (EarthState Grid, EarthState Water, EarthState Bridges & Roads, EarthState Facilities). They are used in joint research and innovation projects with universities and companies. All products are research prototypes; demonstration data are synthetic or from open datasets.

## Pages

- [About](https://earthstate.co.uk/about.html): EarthState is a series of research prototypes for infrastructure digital twins, developed by the research team of Dr.-Ing. Daguang Han, Associate Director of the Transport AI Innovation Centre (TRAICE) at Loughborough University and Associate Professor at Southeast University.
- [AIoT and sensors](https://earthstate.co.uk/aiot.html): EarthState connects sensors to the structural model automatically: each gauge is registered on a model member, its records are checked and corrected, and the twin is calibrated and validated against measurement.
- [Collaborate](https://earthstate.co.uk/collaborate.html): How universities, infrastructure owners and engineering companies can work with the EarthState research prototypes: open demos, walkthroughs and seminars, and joint research and innovation projects on ageing infrastructure.
- [Contact](https://earthstate.co.uk/contact.html): Request a walkthrough of the EarthState research prototypes, or discuss a joint project on an ageing asset, a storm question or an AI decision.
- [Demos](https://earthstate.co.uk/demos/): Try the EarthState platform in the browser: the EarthState Twin function tour and analysis demo and the 3D Lab are open; Standfast and FacilityNexus are shown on request; EarthState Water is in development.
- [EarthState · Research prototypes · World models for infrastructure](https://earthstate.co.uk/): EarthState is a series of research prototypes for digital twins of real infrastructure, developed by Dr Daguang Han's research team: two platforms, EarthState Twin and Standfast, across power grids, water, bridges and roads, and facilities. Every result goes to an engineer for sign-off.
- [3D Lab](https://earthstate.co.uk/lab/): EarthState's 3D Lab: structural models built automatically from drawings and point clouds, shown as a live twin, a photoreal turntable and ray-traced films.
- [Method](https://earthstate.co.uk/method.html): How the EarthState prototypes reach a structural result: drawings and data to a checkable model, code checks to the Eurocodes, a capacity statement and engineer sign-off, with a full audit trail.
- [Automated modelling](https://earthstate.co.uk/modelling.html): EarthState builds structural models automatically from vector PDF drawings, drawing tables and laser-scan point clouds, with self-checks and an audit trail, and writes an IFC information model from the same source.
- [Network](https://earthstate.co.uk/network.html): The universities and research partners the EarthState team works with, and the team lead's project experience in research and development and with industry, on an interactive globe.
- [EarthState Bridges & Roads](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/bridges-roads.html): EarthState Bridges & Roads, in development: from a laser scan or drawings to a bridge model that can be assessed, with repairs ranked by remaining capacity. Built on the shared EarthState core.
- [EarthState Facilities](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/facility-twin.html): EarthState Facilities, with FacilityNexus, a facility operations twin for buildings, estates and airports: a 3D twin base with an event centre, equipment-health diagnostics, an operations knowledge base and an AI assistant on every page.
- [Platform](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/): EarthState has two platforms with different jobs, EarthState Twin and Standfast, and four industry products: EarthState Grid, EarthState Water, EarthState Bridges & Roads and EarthState Facilities. Each is marked Demo, On request or In development.
- [Standfast](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/standfast.html): Standfast looks after assets in service: hazard scenarios across a network, how close each structure is to collapse, and strengthening and maintenance priorities. First built for overhead lines on real terrain under storm loading.
- [EarthState Twin](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/structural-twin.html): EarthState Twin builds a structure's model, digital twin and capacity check from its drawings and records, through a conversation, with a ranked repair list for an engineer to sign off. First built for ageing lattice steel towers.
- [EarthState Water](https://earthstate.co.uk/platforms/water.html): EarthState Water, a reliability twin for pumping stations: one criticality scale, failure modes taken through to maintenance tasks an engineer has confirmed, and stations ranked by risk 72 hours before a storm. In development.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://earthstate.co.uk/privacy.html): How this website handles personal data and cookies.
- [Research and partnerships](https://earthstate.co.uk/research.html): EarthState is a series of research prototypes: structural digital twins, world models for infrastructure, joint research and innovation projects with universities and companies, co-authored papers and shared patents.
- [Work](https://earthstate.co.uk/work.html): Selected work on ageing lattice towers, bridges and infrastructure data, by the team lead, described by asset and decision; owners are not named.
